title: Document the Windows fingerprint ctime exception and metadata-restoration limit
outcome: Clarify the approved Windows metadata-only ctime exception and its residual limit without expanding integrity machinery or changing the approved behavior.
acceptance: The existing fingerprint documentation or source comment states that Windows omits only ctimeNs while retaining dev, ino, mode, size, mtimeNs, byte-count and streamed-content hashing, and POSIX retains ctime comparison.

The same documentation distinguishes bytes hashed during the read from a same-size post-read rewrite that restores mtime, without claiming atomic content capture or adding new checks/retries/configuration changes.
